title: Done means a stranger can see it working.
hook: Our definition of done requires a stranger to see it working.
thesis: In PING, DONE means converged plus integrated plus reached plus verified plus observable. The reached vertex is the test most teams skip: real external evidence that the work actually functions, not activity theater in a status report. This post contrasts that bar with how most teams report progress, and invites the audience to apply it to their own backlog.

verified: DONE is defined as converged plus integrated plus reached plus verified plus observable, and most of the 2026-09-29 backlog was not there yet (SYSTEMS.md section 1).

approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
